key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.9s): Initial archival pose of telephone; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.02s): Mid-sequence articulation of telephone; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.26s): Peak dynamic extension of telephone over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.5s): Follow-through and settle of telephone with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of telephone (0.9s..4.5s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.

source.rights_statement: Moving Image Archive / Public Domain & Archival Research Corpus

design_selection.why: Selected Quick, Draw! human doodle #11 (US, 6 strokes) matched by aspect ratio & structural contour compatibility.
design_selection.method: SCION + Zero-Shot Quick, Draw! Prototype Matcher (top-25 recognized human drawings)
